title: Quenched Peruvian Marsbar Salad
description: A light, earthy Peruvian salad that blends savory quinoa, tender chicken, and roasted sweet potato with a surprising sweet twist from a Mars bar.

ingredients.name: seasoning
ingredients.notes: soy sauce, pinch of salt and pepper

instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C and roast 150g diced sweet potato with 1/4 tbsp olive oil for 20 minutes until tender.
Season 200g chicken breast with salt and pepper, then grill or pan‑sear it over medium heat until fully cooked, about 7 minutes per side, and slice into strips.
Cook 100g quinoa in 200ml water, bring to a boil, reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes until fluffy.
In a skillet, heat 1 tbsp olive oil over medium heat and sauté the cooked quinoa until lightly browned, about 3 minutes.
Add the roasted sweet potato, 100g cherry tomatoes, 100g sliced cucumber, and 50g shredded carrot to the skillet, tossing gently.
Stir in the sliced chicken, 1 tbsp lime juice, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, and 1 tsp seasoning mixture, then season with additional salt and pepper if desired.
Fold in the chopped 1/4 Mars bar, allowing it to slightly melt into the mixture for a sweet contrast.
Serve the warm salad over 1/2 sliced avocado, garnishing with extra cilantro if desired.
